description: Use in standard and deep modes to ask the user your clarifying questions, instead of writing them in your reply. Pass 1-8 questions in the user's language, most important first, each with 2-4 options, the 0-based index of the recommended option and why, its reason in 12 words or fewer; header is an optional tag of up to 12 characters. Where the app supports forms, the user answers one form (recommended answers preselected, plus a notes field; pass intro, notes_label and notes_hint in the user's language) and this returns the answers: source "chosen" means the user picked it; "recommended" means they didn't confirm it, so list it under Assumptions. If the user declines, you get the recommended answers to list under Assumptions. If forms aren't supported, or the user closes the form without answering, it returns the questions as numbered text: show that to the user in their language, then stop and wait for their reply. If the call fails, ask the same questions in your reply in the brief's numbered format.

intro.description: The form's message: one line in the user's language. The form has its own controls, so don't say how to reply. Questions asked in the chat open with their own line instead. Defaults to an English line.

notes_hint.description: The hint under that field, in the user's language. Defaults to "Optional. Anything you write here wins over the choices above."

notes_label.description: The form's free-text field label, in the user's language. Defaults to "Anything to add or change?"

header.description: A tag of up to 12 characters, such as "Audience".

id.description: Short unique identifier such as "audience" or "length" (letters, digits, - and _; "notes" is reserved).

description.description: What choosing it means (optional; shown in forms).

label.description: The option, in the user's language, without a ★: ask_user adds the ★ to the recommended option (write a rating in words, such as "4 stars").

question.description: One decision in plain words, in the user's language.

recommended.description: 0-based index of the recommended option. It must work as the answer if the user accepts it unchanged (the form preselects it, and a decline returns it), so never recommend an option that asks the user for the information, such as "Tell me".

why.description: The reason for the recommended option, 12 words or fewer, in the user's language.

name: ask_user

source.description: chosen: the user picked or confirmed it ([your answer]). recommended: the ★ answer the user did not confirm (list it under Assumptions).

notes.description: Free text from the form, at most 1,000 characters; it wins over the chosen options.

status.description: answered: the user submitted the form. declined: the user declined it, so answers holds the ★ answers. ask_in_chat: no form here, or the user closed it without answering; show questionsText and wait for the reply.

title: Ask the user clarifying questions
